query: SELECT mp.id, mp.userId, mp.university, mp.major, mp.isActive, mp.verificationStatus, mp.isDeleted, u.id as user_id, u.email, u.name FROM mentor_profiles mp LEFT JOIN users u ON mp.userId = u.id WHERE mp.isActive = 1 AND mp.verificationStatus = 'approved' AND mp.isDeleted = 0;
